business_problem: connect dozens of university data sources, shorten time to deliver new data products, and unlock value from unstructured documents for research and operations.
solution_summary: Florida State University uses Snowflake, Document AI, Secure Data Sharing, and Horizon Catalog on Snowflake to connect dozens of university data sources, shorten time to deliver new data products, and unlock value from unstructured documents for research and operations. Student, academic, operational, and document data are centralized in Snowflake so analysts, operators, and business teams can work from a faster, more reliable operating view. Document AI extends the platform beyond structured tables by extracting useful fields from PDFs and other unstructured content. Keeping ingestion, storage, transformation, and governed access on one platform reduces handoffs, simplifies operations, and makes it easier to reuse trusted data across analytics, reporting, and AI. Florida State University achieved 95% Faster time to value for internal stakeholders, sharing data in five days vs. 90 previously and 11x Increase in connected data sources — while accelerating performance.

solution_components.name: Document AI
solution_components.role: Extracts structured values from unstructured documents inside Snowflake.

solution_components.name: Secure Data Sharing
solution_components.role: Shares governed data with partners or internal consumers without moving copies.

solution_components.role: Applies cataloging, governance, and policy controls across Snowflake data assets.
